s38_A_tau0.interpretation_note: Planner interpretation, recorded before running: Addendum 20 defines A by tau = 0 and B by PF balancing, and (c) authorizes a combined run only 'if both help'. A therefore isolates HP1 (proximal off, rho_pf held) and B isolates HP2 (proximal as run 1, PF balancing live); the combination is (c)'s confirmation run. If A also had PF balancing live, A would already be the combination and (c) would be redundant.
s38_A_tau0.production_change_required: the case-file loader rejects tau <= 0 (admm_parameters.py 'must be positive'); relax to tau >= 0 after verifying no code path divides by tau or gamma; the arm sets tau by override
s38_A_tau0.tau_scope: global: tau is one parameter (proximal_regularization.tso.tau) shared by V, PF and ESS, so gamma_v = gamma_pf = gamma_ess = 0 - the TSO proximal term is off on every channel
s38_A_tau0.v_balancing: on (as run 1), with the Addendum 20 freeze rule

s38_A_tau0p25_fallback.launch_condition: only if s38_A_tau0 meets the TSO-instability trigger below; replaces A in the verdict; A's own run and evaluation are kept and reported

s38_B_pfbal.launch_condition: after arm A (and A's fallback, if triggered) has exited; never concurrently
s38_B_pfbal.pf_balancing: ACTIVE: balancing_exempt_channels = ['ess']; freeze after 10 unchanged cycles (with a prior action), absolute freeze at cycle 200
s38_B_pfbal.v_balancing: on (as run 1), with the Addendum 20 freeze rule

s38_C_combined.launch_condition: Addendum 20 (c): only if both A and B 'help' (definition below); prepared in code, launched only after the stop for review
s38_C_combined.order: 3 (NOT authorized to launch by this spec)

capture_requirements: everything v8 captured (ESS entry stride 1, EFC, recourse jump, SoH floor, Boyd terminal, interface settlement/voltage terminal) PLUS per-entry PF capture at every cycle (standard instrumentation from this stage on): for every PF consensus entry (node, year, day, power_type p/q, period): x_DSO, z_TSO current and previous, lambda_DSO, rho_pf and gamma_pf in force, and the per-entry r and s contributions exactly as get_admm_boyd_residual_metrics accumulates them (so the per-entry sums reproduce boyd_pf_r and boyd_pf_s to round-off - asserted per cycle). Also per-cycle rho/gamma per channel with action labels and freeze state. Rule-eleven checklist asserts every capture path and every configuration value (tau in force in the built TSO models' prox_gamma Params, exemption lists, freeze parameters, cap) before any solve.

certification_per_arm.adoption: Addendum 20 (c): if both help, one combined confirmation run (s38_C_combined), launched after review; the adopted configuration becomes the oracle and Step 3.5 follows. If exactly one helps and certifies, it is the candidate oracle configuration, pending review. If neither helps, stop for review.
certified_iff: Boyd stop on all three channels with 3 consecutive converged cycles within 300, derived from the trajectory
no V or PF channel frozen at a rho clamp
terminal system cost within the rule-nine bar of run 1: |Q_arm - Q_run1| <= terminal step (arm) + 256.26; valid only because both runs are then settled
certification_per_arm.helps: an arm HELPS iff its PF channel first passes (primal and dual, same cycle) at or before cycle 180 (at least 20% earlier than run 1's 226), whether or not it certifies

configuration_common.base: spec v8 arm s37_rho0p01 exactly (run 1 configuration via deep-copied parameter overrides; rho_v 0.0077, rho_pf 0.198 initial; rho_ess 0.01 fixed on every network and the ESSO; ESS exempt from balancing; shared_ess_initialization standalone - cold, no LP initialization), never by editing the case file
configuration_common.cap_reading: Addendum 20: the cap is a budget, not a criterion
configuration_common.case_file: data/SRP1/SRP1_params.json is NOT edited by this stage; the adopted configuration is written to the case file only under Addendum 20 (c), after review
configuration_common.freeze_rule: Addendum 20: the cycle-60 backstop is removed for all channels. freeze_after_unchanged_cycles = 10 (Addendum 15 rule: requires at least one prior balancing action on that channel) plus an absolute freeze at cycle 200, implemented as freeze_backstop_cycle = 200 (the backstop parameter IS the absolute all-channel freeze; only its cycle changes)
configuration_common.unchanged: tolerances untouched: Boyd eps_abs 1e-5 / eps_rel 1e-4, 3 consecutive converged cycles; sigma fixed 9.363536e7; al_scale_esso; S_ref 2.5 MVA; D5 ESSO AL scaling; gamma_policy tied_to_rho; balancing dead bands (5.0; PF decrease 3.0), factor 1.5, clamp [1e-4, 1e4]; network recovery policy

mechanism_under_test: Addendum 20 reading HP1 + HP2: (HP1) the TSO proximal term with tau = 1 (gamma = rho) halves the TSO interface step every cycle, so the PF dual residual s = sqrt(rho^2+gamma^2)*||dz_TSO|| decays slowly (~0.988/cycle), invariant to rho_ess; (HP2) rho_pf = 0.198 is too large for the late phase (PF primal well inside tolerance, dual 2.7x outside at cycle 150) while the cycle-60 backstop froze balancing before the imbalance appeared. HP3 (the sqrt(2) accounting) is not a cause.
planner_risk_notes_not_predictions: the Boyd stop also needs the ESS channel to pass for 3 consecutive cycles; at rho_ess 0.01 in s37 the ESS primal ratio hovered 0.92-1.62 after cycle 95 and passed on 13 of cycles 95-150, and Addendum 20 records the ESS channel as unsettled (two-phase schedule deferred). An arm may therefore help on PF yet fail certification on ESS, criterion (a) or (c); the report must attribute the failing criterion per channel
tau = 0 removes the proximal term on V and ESS as well as PF (tau is global); any V or ESS change in A is reported as a confound of the global parameter, not attributed to PF
in B, PF balancing decisions after the first decrease change the trajectory; the (a) zero-solve replay predicts only the first firing on the observed run-1/s37 trajectories

predecessor.note: v8's configuration (rho_ess 0.01 fixed, ESS exempt, cold, standalone init) is the base; v8's arms did not certify (PF-bound at cap 150)

predictions_recorded_in_advance: PF first pass well before 226 in at least one arm - operationalized as PF first channel pass <= 180 in at least one of A, B
A is the stronger candidate - operationalized as A's PF first pass cycle < B's (or A passes PF within 300 and B does not)
report: per arm: certification verdict and failing criteria per channel; cycle count; PF first-pass cycle (and V, ESS); rho/gamma trajectories with action labels; per-entry PF decomposition (share of s^2 and r^2 by node, year, day, p/q, period at matched cycles; late-phase per-group decay rate); cost against run 1's bar (with the settled caveat); local-solve and network failures by tier and agent; oscillation flags; EFC trajectory; whether the fallback trigger fired; the two predictions scored; the 'helps' determination; stop for review
sequencing: (a) zero-solve balancing replay may run at any time (read-only, SolveProfileGuard armed, zero solves)
arm A, then (fallback A' if triggered), then arm B; one at a time, attached, stderr captured, exclusive lock; commit before each launch
Step 3.6 per-phase timing: implementation proceeds in parallel; its timing measurement runs only when no arm is running (never mixed with a numerical gate, Addendum 18)
stop for review after the arms

tso_instability_trigger_for_A_fallback.definition: evaluated on arm A's completed run, before arm B launches. TRIGGERED iff ANY of: (i) any unrecovered TSO (network case9) failure; (ii) TSO (case9) network-failure rate over A's cycles > 2x run 1's rate (58/477 = 0.1216 per cycle), i.e. > 0.2432 per cycle; (iii) OSCILLATION FLAG on the per-entry TSO PF consensus step (z_TSO PF, all nodes/years/days/p-q/periods): sign-change fraction > 0.2 for 10 consecutive cycles, or cosine between consecutive step vectors < 0 for 5 consecutive cycles (the v8 ESS definition applied to PF, entries with |step| < 1e-9 ignored); (iv) the same OSCILLATION FLAG on the ESS stride (v8 definition)
tso_instability_trigger_for_A_fallback.not_a_trigger: failure to certify, slow PF convergence, or DSO failures alone
